explanation: This is 0 almost everywhere: it only fires at the GO step of a late-episode trial (about trials 85-95) when the previous trial was a rare transition (usually a1 reaching S2) that was rewarded, and then it reaches about 8-10, whichever action is chosen. It stays 0 at every D1 and D2 step, after common transitions, after unrewarded rare transitions, and after rewarded rare transitions earlier in the episode (it reaches only about 6 near trial 86 and is often 0 again by trials 97-98).
